# Agent session (Microsoft)

Microsoft's "agent session", in VS Code and Microsoft Agent Framework, is the industry's [session][industry.session], and GitHub says session for the same thing: "the conversation and activity associated with agentic work" ([About Copilot in the cloud][m7]). In VS Code, an agent session holds [chats][microsoft.chat] inside it ([Build with agents][m3]).

## Examples

- An agent session in VS Code ([Build with agents][m3]).
- A session on GitHub, started as an agent task ([About Copilot in the cloud][m7]).
- An agent session in Microsoft Agent Framework ([Agent Framework overview][m5]).
- A session in the Agent Host Protocol, with the chats inside it ([What is AHP][m8]).
